sentences.text:
National
 Insurance Company Ltd.

.... Appellant
 Mr. P.K. Mahali, Advocate
 -versus-
 Sanjaya Kumar Sahoo and Another .... Respondents
 Mr. R.C. Pradhan, counsel for respondent No.1
 Coram:
 Shri Justice B. P. Routray
 Order
16.8.2023 Order No.
The matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Heard Mr. P.K. Mahali, learned counsel for the insurer - appellant and Mr. R.C. Pradhan, learned counsel for the claimant - Respondent No.1.
3.

Present appeal by the insurer - Appellant is directed against the impugned common judgment dated 31st January, 2020 of learned 3rd MACT, Bhubaneswar passed in MAC Case No.375 of 2005,
wherein compensation to the tune of Rs.2,44,455/- along with interest @ 7% per annum from the date of filing of the claim application, i.e. 1 st September, 2005 has been granted on account of injuries sustained by the injured - claimant in the motor vehicular accident dated 23 rd March,
2005.

4. Mr. Mahali submits that the offending vehicle, i.e. Jeep bearing registration number OR-09-A-4166 had 'Act-only' policy on the date of accident and the injured being an occupant of the same cannot be treated as a third party.
5. It is seen that the insurer did not adduce any evidence nor did plead to that effect.
It was never pleaded by the insurer in their WS that the insurance policy in respect of the offending vehicle was for Act-only liability.
The insurer also did not choose to produce the copy of policy before the tribunal.
However, an application praying for additional evidence has been filed before this court recently appending a copy of the insurance policy.
But in absence of any pleading to that effect made by the insurer in their WS, the prayer for adducing additional evidence at this stage is rejected.

sentences.text: For all such reasons stated above, the contentions raised by Mr. Mahali is rejected and the appeal is dismissed.

The appellant - Insurer is directed to deposit the entire compensation amount before the tribunal along with interest as per its direction, within a period of two months from today;
where-after the same shall be disbursed in favour of the claimants on same terms and proportion as contained in the impugned judgment.

7. The statutory deposit made by the insurer - Appellant before this court along with accrued interest be refunded on proper application and on production of proof of deposit of the award amount before the tribunal 8.
The copy of WS as produced by Mr. Mahali is kept on record.
9. An urgent certified copy of this order be issued as per rules.
